title: GitHub Submission Constraint – Request for Alternative Submission Methods

latest.raw:
Hello Team,
Our team is currently working on both Track 1 and Track 2 of the Hackathon. However, our organization does not allow the use of GitHub for project submissions due to internal licensing and compliance policies.

Are there any alternative submission options available? If possible, could you please suggest a couple of alternatives so that we can review them with our IT team and determine which option best aligns with our organization's policies?

You are welcome to set up a Synapse project on Synapse.org and add the **Rare disease real kid MVA hackathon 2026** group (the organizers) to the project.
